description: Returns the AI video, image and audio models this API can generate with: each model's exact parameters (names, allowed values, limits, defaults), the media inputs it takes and its pricing. WHEN: call this, NARROWED and never as the whole catalog, before the first `generate_video`, `generate_image` or `generate_audio` of a session: model ids cannot be guessed, nor can the resolutions, durations or aspect ratios a model allows (`generate_*` rejects a combination not published here). A speech model's `voice` comes from `list_voices`, not from here. NARROW IT, DO NOT PULL IT: the unfiltered listing is several thousand tokens, mostly pricing tables. `query` is free text (send the user's own words; `ignored_query_terms` names the words that matched nothing). `tags` is a closed vocabulary, ANDed, derived from each entry's own fields: `video` / `image` / `audio`, `speech` / `music` / `sound-effects`, `vertical` / `horizontal` / `square`, `image-input` with `start-image` / `end-image` / `reference-image` (or `text-only`), `native-audio` (an `audio` switch, default OFF); `tag_vocabulary` rides on every answer and an unknown tag is a 400. There is no duration tag: durations are searchable (`query: '10'`) and every entry carries its `durations`. `type` is the product, `model` one id. PAGING only if you ask: with no `limit` you get every match. With `limit` the answer carries `total_matching`, `has_more` and `next_cursor`: READ THEM before telling a user something does not exist, and continue with the SAME filters. PRICING, one shape per entry: video and image models carry `pricing`, an enumerated table (the row matching your resolution, duration, quality and audio is the cost); audio models carry `pricing_rates` (per character, minute or second): there is no row to match and you must NOT multiply the rate yourself; use `estimate_only: true` on `generate_audio`.

cursor.description: The previous `next_cursor`. Send the SAME `type` / `model` / `query` / `tags` with it: different filters are a 400, not a restart.

limit.description: 1-100. Omit to get every match (right once filtered); otherwise read `has_more` and `total_matching`.

model.description: Only the model with this exact id (for example `kling-3.0`).

query.description: Free text: the user's own words ('vertical product ad', '4k'). Words that match nothing are dropped and named in `ignored_query_terms`; the rest must all match (an AND).

tags.description: Tags every returned model must carry (an AND), e.g. `['video','vertical','reference-image']`; `tag_vocabulary` rides on every answer and an unknown tag is a 400.

type.description: Only one product: `video`, `image` or `audio`. Omit for all three.

name: list_models
title: List aicut models
